post.description: Public provider endpoint. Requires a valid X-Twilio-Signature and configured AccountSid. Original URL and form body are verified with the official SDK.

200.description: Verified callback accepted; duplicate/older states do not regress delivery.

patch.description: Admin only. Updates confirmed, occupied or completed booking details while preserving lifecycle and financial history. Rechecks version, room capacity and conflicts. Positive price changes create adjustment invoices; negative changes create credit notes.

200.description: Revised booking in data

409.description: Conflicting rooms, stale version or unsupported lifecycle

422.description: Invalid stay, capacity, tariff or financial adjustment

get.summary: Guest-facing booking confirmation for download or sharing
get.description: Active admin or staff_admin only. Returns allowlisted guest/stay/room and current balance information. No internal notes, audit entries, attachment paths or payment references. Responses are private/no-store. Website renders PDF/JPG locally and composes WhatsApp/email messages; no public booking link is created.

200.description: Guest-facing confirmation in data
Public release metadata; no account or infrastructure details.
